name: Trips - Right - Y Slant Pass Right
call: Trips Right Y Slant Pass Right

Y.rule: Take one step up, then slant out flat toward the right sideline, almost along the line of scrimmage. Look for the ball right away.

QB.rule: Take the snap, take one step and throw to the right tight end as he slants out. If he is covered, tuck it and run.

coaching_points: The fullback, widest, goes vertical and takes the corner with him. The slant stays flat underneath.
The slot screens. The tailback pass blocks. If the tight end is covered, tuck it and run.
